$comment: npm names the framework no longer publishes, each with where the code went, and dist-tags no longer in use (`retiredTags`), removed from every published and deprecated name. `vulnerable.fixedIn` names, per package, the first version that no published security advisory affects; every version below it is deprecated with `vulnerable.message`. A maintainer applies these with `node scripts/npm-maintain.mjs` (trusted publishing cannot deprecate or move a tag); an entry already on the registry is skipped, so the list only ever grows.

vulnerable.message: This version is affected by a published security advisory (https://github.com/intelligo-dev/intelligo/security/advisories). Upgrade every @intelligo-dev/* package to the latest release.
